claims.content: To allow a customer to create a new account on the JTV Auctions website by providing registration information.

goal.raw_text: To allow a customer to create a new account on the JTV Auctions website by providing registration information.

claims.content: Customer
The customer is accessing the JTV Auctions website.
The 'Registration Page 1' and 'Registration Page 2' are available as part of the customer-facing website pages.
The customer navigates to the 'Registration Page 1' from the JTV Auctions website.

trigger.raw_text: The customer navigates to the 'Registration Page 1' from the JTV Auctions website.

claims.content: The Customer navigates to 'Registration Page 1'.
The Customer enters required registration information on 'Registration Page 1'.
The system directs the Customer to 'Registration Page 2'.
The Customer completes the remaining registration steps on 'Registration Page 2'.
The system creates the new customer account and grants access to the 'My Account Page'.
The Customer may choose to sign up for a free PayPal account during the registration or payment setup process, which opens www.paypal.com in a separate window.
If the Customer has previously purchased from Amazon, they may click a link to access their existing Amazon Payments account or register for a new one during the registration/payment setup process.
The customer has a new account created on the JTV Auctions website.
The customer is granted access to the 'My Account Page'.

The customer can view and manage their personal information, bids, watch list, and auction history through the 'My Account Page' and its linked pages ('My Current Bids', 'My Bid History', 'My Watch List', 'Recently Ended Auctions').
